Ancient Greek morphology sources

Source paradigms and code: James Tauber, greek-inflexion,
https://github.com/jtauber/greek-inflexion, MIT License.
The generic inflexion engine is also by James Tauber,
https://github.com/jtauber/inflexion, MIT License. The source distributions
and license notices are included in the Roots source under data/greek-inflexion.

The generated supplemental morphology uses the MorphGNT-derived stem lexicon.
MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition, edited by J. K. Tauber (2017), version 6.12,
https://github.com/morphgnt/sblgnt, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.376200.
Morphological analysis and lemmatization are licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/.
Roots filters the lexicon to textbook vocabulary and transforms its stems into
paradigm forms. The SBLGNT text is not included.

DCC Greek Core Vocabulary (source snapshot and extracted verb entries)
Dickinson College Commentaries, https://dcc.dickinson.edu/greek-core-list
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/.
Roots extracts verb entries and adds provisional headword and coverage fields;
frequency ranks and source headwords remain attributed to DCC.
